# media test fixtures

All files are generated by `TestGenerateFixtures` in `../fixtures_gen_test.go`
and committed, so normal test runs never need to regenerate them. Regenerate
from `server/` with ffmpeg (built with libx264, libx265, libwebp and
libaom-av1) on PATH:

```sh
PT_GEN_FIXTURES=1 go test ./internal/media -run TestGenerateFixtures
```

| File | How it is made |
|---|---|
| `exif_rot6.jpg` | Go: a 480x320 gradient (`image/jpeg`, q60) with a hand-built APP1/EXIF segment: IFD0 Orientation 6, Exif IFD DateTimeOriginal `2024:05:06 10:00:00`, GPS IFD 38°43'20.28"N 9°8'21.48"W (38.7223, -9.1393). ffmpeg cannot write these tags, so the TIFF structure is written byte by byte. Displayed size is 320x480. |
| `plain.png` | Go: a 64x48 gradient (`image/png`). |
| `anim.gif` | Go: three 40x30 Plan9-palette frames (`image/gif`). |
| `corrupt.jpg` | Go: `FF D8 FF E0` (JPEG SOI + APP0 marker) followed by 2 KiB of seeded PCG noise. Sniffs as JPEG, fails to decode. |
| `small.webp` | ffmpeg: one 64x48 `testsrc` frame, `libwebp` quality 60. |
| `clip_h264.mp4` | ffmpeg: 1 s 64x48 `testsrc` at 10 fps, `libx264` yuv420p + 440 Hz sine as AAC 32k, `creation_time=2023-01-02T03:04:05Z`, `+faststart`. Browser-playable. |
| `clip_hevc.mov` | ffmpeg: as above but `libx265` (tagged `hvc1`) in a QuickTime container (major brand `qt  `). Not browser-playable. |
| `still.avif` | ffmpeg: one 64x48 `testsrc` frame, `libaom-av1 -still-picture 1`. Exercises the ffmpeg still-image thumbnail path. |

`still.heic` is not committed: the ffmpeg 9.0 build used has no HEIF muxer,
so `TestThumbnailsHEIC` skips. HEIC goes through the same ffmpeg path as
AVIF.

Every file is under 10 KB.
